text.en:
Section four hundred and fourteen of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven, as
amended by section eight of Act Numbered Three thousand and thirty, is hereby amended by providing that
the words "and that the lock registers each time they are opened," shall not be applicable so far as the general
election to be held in the year nineteen hundred and twenty-two is concerned.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 11, 1922.
